gui.broom_closet.wishlist.title: Wishlist
gui.broom_closet.wishlist.help: Press %s while hovering an item in JEI on an inventory to add it to this list. The desired item or block will then highlight in-world and in inventories. Click an entry to remove it from your wishlist.
